0022600161.text: The Brooklyn Nets (1-5, 15th in the East, 5th in the Atlantic and 4.5 games back) visit the New York Knicks (2-4, 11th in the East, 4th in the Atlantic and 3.5 games back) in the 7th game of the Nets' season. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), while New York is without Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Nets lost 0-4 to the Knicks in the 2025-26 season series, and their last meeting, on March 20, 2026 in Brooklyn, ended 93-92 in New York's favor.
